title: The Garden Of Evening Mists
author: Tan Twan Eng
quote: I stop when i see the pair of statues, Mnemosyne and her nameless twin sister. The Goddess of Memory has remained unchanged but, to my dismay, her sister's face is almost worn smooth, her features rubbed away.

title: Flowers For Algernon
author: Daniel Kayes
quote: Please... please... dont let me forget how to reed and rite...

title: Hell Screen
author: Ryuunosuke Akutagawa
quote: I could have sworn that the man's eyes were no longer watching his daughter dying in agony, that instead the gorgeous colors of flames and the sight of a woman suffering in them were giving him joy beyond measure.

title: The Spider's Thread
author: Ryuunosuke Akutagawa
quote: Listen to me, you sinners! This spider thread is mine! Who said you could climb it? Get off! Get off!

title: No Longer Human
author: Osamu Dazai
quote: Now I have neither happiness nor unhappiness. Everything passes.

title: Lonely Castle In The Mirror
author: Mizuki Tsujimura
quote: I mean, you're battling every single day, aren't you?
